I could not forgive myself if this young innocent was killed.|[[Drakka Judarrl]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Drakka Judarrl|Dantooine}}</ref>}}
A '''Dantari raider''' lived on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This [[Dantari]] was the child of a Dantari chieftain that allied with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Drakka Judarrl]] in resistance actions against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:DJ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Dantari raider was attacked by Imperial troops and was about to be killed when they were rescued by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer dispatched by Drakka Judarrl.<ref name="SWG:DJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateDantariRaider.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of the Dantari raider]]
The Dantari raider was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because this character spawned under the generic "dantari_raider" template, his name and appearance were randomized under one of two possible depictions after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:DJ" />
